title: Refactor per-currency branches into one registry, preserving output, and add register_currency

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: for USD/GBP/EUR/CHF/JPY, output identical to the current implementation for every int amount (checked against a frozen copy of it).
Rule 1: every letter case of the code gives the current output.
Rule 1: non-int amount (including bool) raises TypeError, unchanged.
Rule 1: unsupported code raises UnknownCurrencyError (subclass of ValueError), unchanged.
Rule 2: registering any built-in code again (any letter case) raises ValueError.
Rule 3: code is case-insensitive and must not already be registered.
Rule 3: code must be exactly three ASCII letters, else ValueError.
Rule 3: symbol must be non-empty; failure leaves the registry unchanged.
Rule 3: decimals must be an int from 0 to 4; failure leaves the registry unchanged.
Rule 3: position must be 'prefix' or 'suffix'; failure leaves the registry unchanged.
Rule 3: each failure leaves the registry unchanged (the code is still free).
Rule 4: suffix body with a space; negative sign at the very start; code case-insensitive.
Rule 4: suffix body without space; grouping with thousands_sep; sign at start.
Rule 4: prefix body without space; sign at the very start.
Rule 4: for a prefix symbol with space=True the - goes directly before the number.
Rule 4: fraction zero-padded to decimals digits (divmod by 10 ** decimals).
Rule 4: decimals up to 4; prefix+space sign placement.
Rule 4: decimals == 0 means no decimal separator at all.
Rule 3: an empty thousands_sep means no grouping.
Rule 4: groups joined by thousands_sep, followed by decimal_sep (strings used verbatim).
Rule 1: TypeError behavior for non-int amounts unchanged (applies before currency lookup).
Rule 3: register_currency(...) -> None.
